scripts.git:setup: node -e "const cp=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const root=process.cwd();const source='AGENTS.md';const aliases=['CLAUDE.md','GEMINI.md'];const run=(cmd,args)=>cp.execFileSync(cmd,args,{stdio:'inherit'});run('git',['config','--local','core.symlinks','true']);const repoCli=process.platform==='win32'&&fs.existsSync(path.join(root,'cli.exe'))?{cmd:path.join(root,'cli.exe'),args:['configure']}:{cmd:'go',args:['run','./repo/cli','configure']};run(repoCli.cmd,repoCli.args);for(const alias of aliases){const aliasPath=path.join(root,alias);if(fs.existsSync(aliasPath))fs.rmSync(aliasPath,{force:true});try{fs.symlinkSync(source,aliasPath,'file');}catch(error){if(process.platform!=='win32')throw error;fs.linkSync(path.join(root,source),aliasPath);}}"

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const cp=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const pkgPath=path.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules','lightningcss','package.json');if(!fs.existsSync(pkgPath))process.exit(0);const version=require(pkgPath).version;const report=process.report?.getReport?.();const libc=process.platform==='linux'?(report?.header?.glibcVersionRuntime?'gnu':'musl'):'';const key=[process.platform,process.arch,libc].filter(Boolean).join('/');const pkgByKey={'win32/x64':'lightningcss-win32-x64-msvc','win32/arm64':'lightningcss-win32-arm64-msvc','darwin/x64':'lightningcss-darwin-x64','darwin/arm64':'lightningcss-darwin-arm64','linux/x64/gnu':'lightningcss-linux-x64-gnu','linux/x64/musl':'lightningcss-linux-x64-musl','linux/arm64/gnu':'lightningcss-linux-arm64-gnu','linux/arm64/musl':'lightningcss-linux-arm64-musl'};const platformPkg=pkgByKey[key];if(!platformPkg)process.exit(0);if(fs.existsSync(path.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules',platformPkg)))process.exit(0);if(process.platform==='win32'){cp.execFileSync(process.env.ComSpec||'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe',['/d','/s','/c','npm install --no-save '+platformPkg+'@'+version],{stdio:'inherit'});}else{cp.execFileSync('npm',['install','--no-save',platformPkg+'@'+version],{stdio:'inherit'});}"
